dialogues.speaker: Nefedov
dialogues.text: That's right. This Volkodlak-founded, Volkodlak-run outfit, serving one and all in Snezhnaya... I run it, sure as snowfall.

dialogues.speaker: Nefedov
dialogues.text: Anyway, if you came to ask about that, I'm afraid we'll have to cut this conversation short. Got work to do and all.
